versions.subject: rules: bitsadmin coverage
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\bitsadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' /transfer '
        - ' /create '
        - ' /addfile '
selection_extension:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'http://1'
        - 'http://2'
        - 'http://3'
        - 'http://4'
        - 'http://5'
        - 'http://6'
        - 'http://7'
        - 'http://8'
        - 'http://9'
        - 'https://1'
        - 'https://2'
        - 'https://3'
        - 'https://4'
        - 'https://5'
        - 'https://6'
        - 'https://7'
        - 'https://8'
        - 'https://9'
condition: all of selection*
